title: Pleader
summary: PLE'ADER, noun One who argues in a court of justice. 1. One that forms pleas or pleadings; as a special pleader 2. One that offers reasons for or against; one that attempts to maintain by arguments. S

inlines.v: PLE'ADER, noun One who argues in a court of justice. 1. One that forms pleas or pleadings; as a special pleader 2. One that offers reasons for or against; one that attempts to maintain by arguments. So fair a pleader any cause may gain.
